cases.title: 3-D: a midpoint of a cube vertex and a stated point stays the midpoint (#2798)
cases.lookFor: In every drawing M sits on segment AP, halfway, while the cube moves.
cases.before: M was drawn 1–4 units off AP, every line green.

cases.title: 3-D: a midpoint of two stated points never moves with the cube (#2798)
cases.lookFor: M stays at (2.5, 1, 2) in every drawing while the cube moves.

cases.title: 3-D: a true statement about the midpoint is accepted (#2798)
cases.lookFor: The last line is no longer refused: it answers «זה כבר קיים באיור» (3-D's answer for a held fact until #2790 lands).

cases.title: 3-D: a point on the plane through two cube vertices and a stated point builds (#2798)
cases.lookFor: Accepted; E drawn on that plane.

cases.title: 3-D: a plane's crossing with a cube's diagonal stays on it (#2798, found in round)
lines: המישור π1 חותך את AC' בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: E is on AC' and on π1 in every drawing.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube's size beside a point on the positive x-axis is accepted (#2789, the report)
lines: P נמצא על החלק החיובי של ציר ה-x
cases.lookFor: The size is accepted, the edge is 4, P is on the positive x-axis, the axes are drawn, and the cube moves on each press.
cases.before: The size was refused and P sat on edge AB.

cases.title: 3-D: size first, then the axis point (#2789)
lines: P נמצא על החלק החיובי של ציר ה-x
cases.lookFor: The length stays green and the edge stays 4.
cases.before: The length turned red and the cube shrank back.

cases.title: 3-D: a box keeps a point stated on the x-axis on the axis (#2789)
cases.lookFor: P is on the x-axis in every drawing.
cases.before: P was drawn off the axis at most seeds, every line green.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube's size beside a line through the origin is accepted (#2789)
cases.lookFor: The size is accepted.

cases.title: 3-D REFUSAL: a cube's size beside a stated point off the origin is still refused (#2789; #2792 next)
cases.lookFor: The size is still refused: «נתון גודל מספרי על גוף עם ממדים חופשיים עדיין לא נתמך כאן» (that family is #2792, next round).

cases.title: 3-D: a point equally far from two triangle vertices builds (#2804, the report)
cases.lookFor: T is drawn with the «created T» notice; the row reads «|TA| = |TB|»; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves T.

cases.title: 3-D: the same over a quadrilateral in a circle (#2804)
cases.lookFor: Builds, T drawn.

cases.title: 3-D: «AT = BT» on an empty page draws three separate points (#2804)
cases.lookFor: A, B and T are three separate dots, with T equally far from A and B.
cases.before: Built with A and B on one dot.

cases.title: 3-D: a definition still defines — «AT = TB» makes T the midpoint (#2804, regression guard)
cases.lookFor: T is the midpoint of AB.

cases.title: 3-D REFUSAL: a negative coefficient is still refused (#2804)
cases.lookFor: Refused, naming T.

cases.title: 3-D: nine separate shapes answer fast and the earlier ones never jump (#2764, the report)
cases.lookFor: Each line answers within about a second, and the shapes already drawn never move when the next one is added. (Separate shapes may land in different places than before — your «3 - yes».)
cases.before: Lines 7–9 took 6, 8 and 39 s, and line 9 redrew every shape.

cases.title: 3-D: a quadrilateral in a circle stays put when an unrelated rhombus is added (#2764)
cases.lookFor: ABCD does not move when the rhombus appears.
cases.verifiedBy: lock: src3d/__tests__/issue-2764-independent-parts.test.ts asserts ABCD moves 0 when the rhombus (and a second circle on EFGH) is added, seeds 0–3 (#2791 rows); a single screenshot cannot show «did not move»

cases.title: 3-D: a line linking two squares still holds (#2764, your Q-2764a «b»)
cases.lookFor: Every row green.

cases.title: 2-D: two circles' views each hold the case they claim (#2240, the report)
cases.lookFor: Across the presses the views go crossing → separate → one inside the other, repeating; a «separate» or «inside» view is never two crossing circles.
cases.before: Press 1 («separate») and press 8 («inside») drew crossing circles.

cases.title: 2-D: a pair forced apart stays apart on every press (#2240, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: The forced pair holds its one case at every press (by the lock). In the browser this spelling draws four circles — #2413.
cases.before: The same picture; each press now takes about 0.15 s instead of 0.02 s (accepted, «8 - 1»).
cases.verifiedBy: lock: the #2240 scenario bare-circle-pair-configurations-2240 and displayable-config.test.ts (forced pair settles on its one case, every press). The browser spelling here does not reach the bare pair: the naming lines draw two NEW circles (an existing bug, #2413, commented 2026-11-10)

cases.title: 2-D: stated containment stays contained (#2240, regression guard)
cases.lookFor: One circle inside the other at every press.
